alt: An Apple Mac Studio silver compact desktop computer shown from the front with '512 GB' displayed in large overlaid text, and the Apple Mac Studio logo below
story: On October 28, 2026, Apple started selling the Mac Studio M5 Ultra with 512GB of unified RAM for $22,299 — or $29,799 with 16TB of storage; Macworld pointed out that buying two 256GB Mac Studios would give you the same total RAM, twice the storage, and two processors, for about $700 less.
why_funny: Apple put more RAM in a compact desktop than most cloud servers, priced it at new-car money, and the workaround to get the same specs cheaper is to buy two of them.
